about_the_game:
Ages of Cataria is a cozy story generation game. Every story begins with a family embarking and then settling on a new land called "Cataria". Here, the villagers will have to build out their comforts and find their roles in this new society.

Over time, others will join your settlement, and some will find love and start new families around town. Experience these generational stories as your villagers age over time.

short_description: Set in a new fantastical world, Ages of Cataria is a cozy-friendly town sim. Watch as your village evolves from humble beginnings to a community of multiple families living together across generations of time.
